Priya Menon: Morning all — huge shoutout to Claire Liu and Facilities for fixing the espresso spout right before the all-hands. Literally saved morning morale :coffee::tada:
Mateo Gonzalez: Legend. Claire, you deserve a cape.
Claire Liu: lol nobody said it would be glamorous — unplugged it, tightened a screw, told it to behave. also shoutout to Anna (Support) who stayed late to patch the signup Airtable script so new hires could onboard today.
Anna (Support): happy to help! logs I checked: `signup-sync/2026-03-22.log` — turned out to be a schema mismatch. ping me if you want the patch PR.
Facilities Team: On-site tech (and cookie bribe) did the trick. Cookie count: 3 :cookie:
kudos-bot: Awarded 5 kudos to Claire Liu and 3 kudos to Anna (Support) :trophy:
Devon (Product): Coffee + onboarding = 10/10 all-hands. Anyone want a celebratory coffee run? I'll fund the round :coffee:
Priya Menon: Yes please! Meeting spot outside kitchen in 15. Again, massive thanks — little non-glam fixes have outsized impact :heart:
